PATENTS ACT 1983

Patents (Waiver of Fee) Regulations 2020

In exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 87(2)(e) of the Patents

Act 1983 [Act 291], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Patents (Waiver of Fee)

Regulations 2020.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 1 January 2021.

Interpretation

2. For the purpose of these Regulations, "control or prevention measures"

means measures prescribed, made or taken under the Prevention and Control

of Infectious Diseases Act 1988 [Act 342] intended to control or prevent the

spread of the Coronavirus Diseases 2019 (COVID-19).

Waiver of fee

3. (1) The fee prescribed in item 18 of the Part II, Schedule I to the Patents

Regulations 1986 [P.U. (A) 327/1986] is waived in respect of an owner of a

patent or a certificate for a utility innovation who is affected with the control

or prevention measures.

P.U. (A) 392.

(2) The waiver under subregulation (1) shall apply if:

(a) the term of a patent or certificate for a utility innovation expires

between 1 January 2021 to 30 June 2021; and

(b) an application for waiver of fee under subregulation (1) is filed with

the Registrar accompanied with payment of the annual fee within the

grace period of six months pursuant to subsection 35(2) of the Act

for patent and modification to subsection 35(4) under the Second

Schedule of the Act for certificate for a utility innovation, as the

case maybe.

Application for waiver of fee

4. (1) An application for the waiver of fee under regulation 3 shall be

made by the owner of the patent or the certificate for a utility innovation in

Form 1 of the Schedule and shall be accompanied with the supporting

documents to prove that:

(a) if he is an individual:

(i) he is from B40 group who receives Bantuan Sara Hidup or

Bantuan Prihatin Nasional; or

(ii) he lose his job and income, or his income is affected with the

control or prevention measures ; or

(b) if it is a body corporate or unincorporated:

(i) such body obtains the approval for the extension of moratorium

or any flexibility for repayment from any financial institution;

(ii) such body has cash flow problem due to the control or prevention

measures; or

(iii) such body has pecuniary indebtedness and has problem on

repayment of debt due to the control or prevention measures.

(2) In the case of a patent or certificate for a utility innovation which has

more than one owner, the requirement under subregulation (1) is deemed to

be complied with if one of the owners satisfy such requirement.

(3) If the owner of the patent or certificate for a utility innovation fails

to file an application for waiver of fee accompanied with payment of the

annual fee under paragraph 3(2)(b), subsection 35(3) of the Act for patent or

modification to subsection 35(5) under the Second Schedule of the Act for

certificate for a utility innovation, as the case maybe, shall apply.

P.U. (A) 392.

AKTA CAP DAGANGAN 2019

Peraturan-Peraturan Cap Dagangan

(Penepian dan Pengubahsuaian Fi) 2020

Pada menjalankan kuasa yang diberikan oleh perenggan 162(2)(f) Akta Cap

Dagangan 2019 [Akta 815], Menteri membuat peraturan-peraturan yang berikut:

Nama dan permulaan berkuat kuasa

1. (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan Cap

Dagangan (Penepian dan Pengubahsuaian Fi) 2020.

(2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Januari 2021.

Takrifan

2. Bagi maksud Peraturan-Peraturan ini, "langkah-langkah pengawalan atau

pencegahan" ertinya langkah-langkah yang ditetapkan, dibuat dan diambil

di bawah Akta Pencegahan dan Pengawalan Penyakit Berjangkit 1988

[Akta 342] yang bertujuan untuk mengawal atau mencegah merebaknya Penyakit

Koronavirus 2019 (COVID-19).

Penepian fi

3. (1) Fi yang dikenakan kepada mana-mana individu, perkongsian,

persatuan, pertubuhan perbadanan atau institusi di bawah Jadual Pertama

Peraturan-Peraturan Cap Dagangan 2019 [P.U. (A) 373/2019] diketepikan bagi

perkara yang berikut:

(a) berhubung dengan butiran 7, permohonan pindaan nama atau alamat

rumah pemohon dan pembetulan nama atau alamat rumah tuan punya

berdaftar;

(b) berhubung dengan butiran 27, permohonan pelanjutan masa bagi

prosiding lain selain bangkangan; dan

(c) berhubung dengan butiran 32, pemfailan dokumen secara manual.

(2) Penepian di bawah perenggan 1(a) dan (b) hendaklah terpakai bagi

mana-mana individu, perkongsian, persatuan, pertubuhan perbadanan atau

institusi yang terkesan dengan langkah-langkah pengawalan atau pencegahan

dan tertakluk kepada peraturan 4.

P.U. (A) 393.

Permohonan bagi penepian fi

4. (1) Permohonan bagi penepian fi di bawah perenggan 3(1)(a) dan (b)

hendaklah—

(a) dibuat dalam borang yang ditentukan oleh Pendaftar;

(b) dibuat dalam tempoh antara 1 Januari 2021 hingga 30 Jun 2021; dan

(c) disertakan dengan dokumen sokongan untuk membuktikan bahawa:

(i) bagi apa-apa permohonan yang dibuat oleh individu:

(A) pemohon adalah daripada kumpulan B40 yang layak

untuk menerima Bantuan Sara Hidup atau Bantuan

Prihatin Nasional; atau

(B) pendapatannya terkesan dengan langkah-langkah

pengawalan atau pencegahan; atau

(ii) bagi apa-apa permohonan yang dibuat oleh mana-mana

perkongsian, persatuan, pertubuhan perbadanan atau institusi

pemohon:

(A) telah memperoleh kelulusan bagi penyambungan

moratorium atau apa-apa fleksibiliti pembayaran balik

daripada mana-mana institusi kewangan;

(B) mempunyai masalah aliran tunai akibat langkah-langkah

pengawalan atau pencegahan; atau

(C) menghadapi keberhutangan dan kesulitan membuat

pembayaran balik hutang akibat langkah-langkah

pengawalan atau pencegahan.

(2) Jika permohonan bagi pendaftaran cap dagangan atau cap dagangan

berdaftar mempunyai lebih daripada seorang tuan punya, kehendak di bawah

subperenggan 1(c)(i) atau (ii) disifatkan telah dipatuhi jika salah seorang tuan

punya mematuhi kehendak tersebut.

Pengubahsuaian fi

5. (1) Tertakluk kepada peraturan 6, fi yang dikenakan kepada mana-mana

individu, perkongsian, persatuan, pertubuhan perbadanan atau institusi

yang terkesan oleh langkah-langkah pengawalan atau pencegahan di bawah

Peraturan-Peraturan Cap Dagangan 2019 [P.U. (A) 373/2019] bagi butiran dan

perkara yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1) dan ruang (2) Jadual diubah suai

sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (3).

P.U. (A) 393.

(2) Pengubahsuaian fi di bawah subperaturan (1) hendaklah terpakai bagi

pendaftaran cap dagangan yang habis tempoh antara 1 Januari 2021 hingga

30 Jun 2021.

Permohonan bagi pengubahsuai fi

6. (1) Permohonan bagi pengubahsuaian fi di bawah subperaturan 5(1)

hendaklah—

(a) dibuat dalam borang yang ditentukan oleh Pendaftar;

(b) dibuat dalam tempoh enam bulan selepas tarikh habis tempoh

pendaftaran yang disebut dalam subseksyen 39(5) Akta; dan

(c) disertakan dengan dokumen sokongan untuk membuktikan

bahawa:

(i) bagi apa-apa permohonan yang dibuat oleh individu:

(A) pemohon adalah daripada kumpulan B40 yang layak

untuk menerima Bantuan Sara Hidup atau Bantuan

Prihatin Nasional; atau

(B) pendapatannya terkesan dengan langkah-langkah

pengawalan atau pencegahan; atau

(ii) bagi apa-apa permohonan yang dibuat oleh mana-mana

perkongsian, persatuan, pertubuhan perbadanan atau institusi

pemohon:

(A) telah memperoleh kelulusan bagi penyambungan

moratorium atau apa-apa fleksibiliti pembayaran balik

daripada mana-mana institusi kewangan;

(B) mempunyai masalah aliran tunai akibat langkah-langkah

pengawalan atau pencegahan; atau

(C) menghadapi keberhutangan dan kesulitan membuat

pembayaran balik hutang akibat langkah-langkah

pengawalan atau pencegahan.

(2) Jika permohonan bagi pendaftaran cap dagangan atau cap dagangan

berdaftar mempunyai lebih daripada seorang tuan punya, kehendak di bawah

subperenggan 1(c)(i) atau (ii) disifatkan telah dipatuhi jika salah seorang tuan

punya mematuhi kehendak tersebut.

P.U. (A) 393.

TRADEMARKS ACT 2019

Trademarks (Waiver and Modification of Fee) Regulations 2020

In exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 162 (2)(f) of the Trademarks

Act 2019 [Act 815], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Trademarks (Waiver and

Modification of Fee) Regulations 2020.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 1 January 2021.

Interpretation

2. For the purpose of these Regulations, "control or prevention measures"

means measures prescribed, made or taken under the Prevention and Control

of Infectious Diseases Act 1988 [Act 342] intended to control or prevent the

spread of the Coronavirus Diseases 2019 (COVID-19).

Waiver of fee

3. (1) The fees imposed to any individual, partnership, association, body

corporate or institution under the First Schedule of the Trademarks Regulations

2019 [P.U. (A) 373/2019] are waived for the following matters:

(a) in respect of item 7, application for amendment of name or address of

applicant and correction of name or address of registered proprietor;

P.U. (A) 393.

(b) in respect of item 27, request for extension of time for other than

opposition proceedings; and

(c) in respect of item 32, filing of document manually.

(2) The waiver under paragraphs 1(a) and (b) shall apply to any individual,

partnership, association, body corporate or institution affected with the control

or prevention measures and subject to regulation 4.

Application for waiver of fee

4. (1) An application for a waiver of fees under paragraphs 3(1)(a) and (b)

shall be—

(a) made in the form as determined by the Registrar;

(b) made within the period of 1 January 2021 until 30 June 2021; and

(c) accompanied with the supporting document to prove that—

(i) for any application made by an individual:

(A) the applicant is from the B40 group who is entitled

for the Household Living Aid or Prihatin National

Aid; or

(B) his income is affected with the control or prevention

measures; or

(ii) for any application made by any partnership, association, body

corporate or institution, the applicant:

(A) has obtained approval for the extension of moratorium

or any repayment flexibility from any financial

institution;

(B) has cash flow problem affected with the control or

prevention measures; or

(C) has pecuniary indebtedness and problem on repayment

of debts affected with the control or prevention

measures.

(2) If an application for registration of trademark or a registered trademark

has more than one proprietor the requirements under subparagraphs (1)(c)(i)

or (ii) are deemed to be complied with if one of the proprietors satisfies such

requirements.

P.U. (A) 393.

Modification of fee

5. (1) Subject to regulation 6, the fee imposed to any individual, partnership,

association, body corporate or institution affected with the control or prevention

measures in the Trademarks Regulations 2019 [P.U. (A) 373/2019] for item and

matter as specified in column (1) and column (2) of the Schedule is modified

as specified in column (3).

(2) The modification of fee under subregulation (1) shall be applied to the

registration of trademark which expires between 1 January 2021 until 30 June 2021.

Application for modification of fee

6. (1) An application for modification of fee under subregulation 5(1)

shall be—

(a) made in the form as determined by the Registrar;

(b) made within the period of six months after the date of expiry of

registration referred to in subsection 39(5) of the Act; and

(c) accompanied with the supporting document to prove that—

(i) for any application made by an individual:

(A) the applicant is from the B40 group who is entitled

for the Household Living Aid or Prihatin National

Aid; or

(B) his income is affected with the control or prevention

measures; or

(ii) for any application made by any partnership, association, body

corporate or institution the applicant:

(A) has obtained approval for the extension of moratorium

or any repayment flexibility from any financial

institution;

(B) has cash flow problem affected with the control or

prevention measures; or

(C) has pecuniary indebtedness and problem on repayment

of debts affected with the control or prevention

measures.

(2) If an application for registration of trademark or a registered trademark

has more than one proprietor the requirements under subparagraphs (1)(c)(i)

or (ii) are deemed to be complied with if one of the proprietors satisfies such

requirements.

P.U. (A) 393.
